## Appearance

Geraldine is a queenly blonde possessing hair like spun gold and an alabaster brow. Her eyes are described as a velvety purple.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P13](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P15](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0015)_
